History of Present Illness:
27-year-old woman. One day of persistent pain under the right ribs with vomiting. She is eight weeks postpartum and has no urinary symptoms.

Physical Examination:
Right upper-quadrant tenderness with inspiratory arrest on palpation. Temperature 38.0 C; heart rate 94/min; BP 128/70 mmHg; respiratory rate 18/min; SpO2 97% on room air.

Laboratory Tests:
WBC: 12.9 10^9/L (reference 4.0-11.0)
Hemoglobin: 13.1 g/dL (reference 12.0-17.5)
Platelets: 262 10^9/L (reference 150-400)
Sodium: 136 mmol/L (reference 135-145)
Potassium: 3.7 mmol/L (reference 3.5-5.0)
Creatinine: 1.0 mg/dL (reference 0.6-1.3)
CRP: 99 mg/L (reference <5)
Lipase: 38 U/L (reference 13-60)
ALT: 60 U/L (reference 7-45)
AST: 49 U/L (reference 10-40)
Alkaline phosphatase: 97 U/L (reference 40-130)
Total bilirubin: 1.0 mg/dL (reference 0.2-1.2)
Serum pregnancy test: negative (reference negative)

Imaging Findings:
Ultrasound abdomen: gallbladder-neck stone, distension, 5 mm wall and focal probe tenderness; common bile duct 3 mm.
